svg.title: Intent to spec: human-agent clarification and approval
svg.desc: Selected Teams conversations, relevant Confluence pages, and other human input inform human-owned Jira Epic intent and an agent-drafted Jira Story based on a template. Humans and the agent clarify missing information and revise the draft until a person approves the ready specification in Jira. Unresolved intent loops back for clarification; the approved Story becomes input to technical planning.
svg.text: Intent to spec: clarify before approval
Epic intent stays human-owned; the Story becomes the delivery spec.

g.text: 2. Agent drafts Jira Story from template
Teams and Confluence inform human-owned why, what, outcome, constraints, and owner.
Scenarios, data and interfaces, quality needs, acceptance expectations,
dependencies, and non-goals become explicit draft content.
Questions return to the owner; the agent revises the draft.
Unresolved intent or consequential choices block approval.
The approved spec and its source links feed technical planning.

svg.text: Teams and Confluence supply scoped input; Jira holds approved intent, Story readiness, and decisions.
